limitations: Only the specified complex quintic pencil and its isolated surface singularities; not a claim about all quintic surfaces, limiting line configurations, positive-characteristic degenerations, monodromy or total-space singularities. Broader historical priority remains subject to external literature comparison.
scientific_integrity: The affine smoothness criterion t not equal 0,1 is already Yu and Zhu Lemma 3.1 and is not original here. New claims are exhaustive local singularity baskets, their analytic types and their Milnor, exceptional-resolution, and Euler data, proved for the displayed characteristic-zero pencil. Exact symbolic computation checks critical identities; an independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Singular fibers of the 85-line quintic pencil: twenty-four nodes and an ordinary quadruple point
